```{r}
# Charger le package patchwork pour combiner les graphiques
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(latex2exp)
library(ggplot2)

#non_duplicated_indispo$year <- year(non_duplicated_indispo$electricity_delivery_date)


plot_data <- non_duplicated_indispo %>% 
  dplyr::select(electricity_delivery_date, Unavailable.Capacity, plant_type) %>% 
  group_by(plant_type) %>% 
  summarise(Unavailable.Capacity.mean = mean(as.numeric(Unavailable.Capacity)),
         n_indispo = n()) 


rf_indispo <- indispo_rf %>% 
  dplyr::select(c("production_resource_psr_name" ,"electricity_delivery_date", "mrid",
               "Installed.Capacity","Unavailable.Capacity", "plant_type", "duration", "predicted_real_unavailability", "datetime_slot")) %>% 
  full_join(non_duplicated_indispo %>% 
          dplyr::select(c("production_resource_psr_name" ,"electricity_delivery_date", "mrid",
               "Installed.Capacity","Unavailable.Capacity", "plant_type")), 
        by = c("production_resource_psr_name" ,"electricity_delivery_date", "mrid",
               "Installed.Capacity","Unavailable.Capacity", "plant_type") )

rf_indispo <- rf_indispo %>% 
  group_by(mrid) %>% 
  summarise(plant_type = first(plant_type),
            duration = first(duration),
            predicted_real_unavailability = mean(predicted_real_unavailability, na.rm = TRUE),
            duration_rf = n(),
            electricity_delivery_date = first(electricity_delivery_date),
            production_resource_psr_name = first(production_resource_psr_name)
            ) %>% 
  ungroup()
colnames(rf_indispo)

class(rf_indispo$predicted_real_unavailability)
rf_plot_data <- rf_indispo %>% 
  filter(predicted_real_unavailability < -50) %>% 
  dplyr::select(electricity_delivery_date, predicted_real_unavailability, plant_type, duration_rf) %>% 
  group_by(plant_type) %>% 
  summarise(predicted_real_unavailability = mean(predicted_real_unavailability, na.rm = TRUE),
            duration_rf = mean(as.numeric(duration_rf, na.rm = TRUE) ),
         n_indispo = n())

```

```{r}
plot1 <- ggplot() +

           stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(y = "Unavailable.Capacity") +
theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), # Désactiver le titre de l'axe des x
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")  # Désactiver les ticks de l'axe des x

  labs( y = "Event count", fill = "Fuel type") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust =1),
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

plot2 <-plot2 +

  # Ajouter un titre personnalisé comme annotation
  #+annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = "Number of Power Outages", 
           #hjust = 1.4, vjust = -1.5, size = 5)
# Assembler les deux graphiques verticalement avec patchwork

# Combine the grid with the legend
final_plot <- plot_grid(combined_plot, custom_legend ,
                        ncol = 2, rel_heights = c(1, 0.1))



# Afficher le graphique combiné
final_plot
```




Those figures are to be compared with the total capacity installed in Spain that is between 120 (ENTSOE platform data for 2024) and 150 GW (sum of IIP installed capacity).
The daily generation of energy is about 80 GWh.
The hourly generation power ranges between 20 GW at the night without wind and 40 GW during the day
(not very clear on the entsoe website)

Thus, the kind of shocks that we are looking at are in magnitude of 500 MW to 2GW that is at most 2% of electricity generation.

Nota bene: it could depend on whether this plant was supposed to generate electricity, maybe get the generation schedule, to deduce which have low marginal cost,
maybe it depends from fuel type and whether or not 'pilotable'

This magnitude is rather small.
Yet, we expect that the price setting mechanism of marginal pricing will have a substantial (and maybe discontinuous) impact on prices by forcing a new high-cost unit to produce on the market.


Je veux montrer à la fni ce à quoi resseble ma shock serie

```{r}

save_path_entsoe_output <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/Intra_day_micro/outputs/final/OMIE'
setwd(save_path_entsoe_output)

first_stage_data <- read_parquet('first_stage_data_OMIE.parquet') 

intraday_price_indispo_data <- first_stage_data %>% 
  mutate(Published.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         # Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         # Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity

         ) %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date) %>% 
  summarise(
    Published = ifelse(all(Published.Unavailable.Capacity <= 0 | is.na(Published.Unavailable.Capacity)), 
                       0, 
                       mean(Published.Unavailable.Capacity[Published.Unavailable.Capacity > 0], na.rm = TRUE)),
    # Published_Dismissed = ifelse(all(Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity <= 0 | is.na(Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity)), 
    #                    0, 
    #                    mean(Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity[Published.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity > 0], na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    Unpublished = ifelse(all(Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity <= 0 | is.na(Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity)), 
                         0, 
                         mean(Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity[Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity > 0], na.rm = TRUE))
    # Unpublished_Dismissed = ifelse(all(Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity <= 0 | is.na(Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity)), 
    #                      0, 
    #                      mean(Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity[Unpublished.Dismissed.Unavailable.Capacity > 0], na.rm = TRUE))
  )





predict_intraday_price_indispo_data <- first_stage_data %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date) %>% 
  summarise(
    Published = ifelse(all(Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity <= 0 | is.na(Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity)), 
                       0, 
                       mean(Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity[Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity > 0], na.rm = TRUE)),
    # Published_Dismissed = ifelse(all(Published.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity <= 0 | is.na(Published.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity)), 
    #                    0, 
    #                    mean(Published.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity[Published.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity > 0], na.rm = TRUE)),
    
    Unpublished = ifelse(all(Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity <= 0 | is.na(Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity)), 
                         0, 
                         mean(Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity[Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity > 0], na.rm = TRUE))#,
    # Unpublished_Dismissed = ifelse(all(Unpublished.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity <= 0 | is.na(Unpublished.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity)), 
    #                      0, 
    #                      mean(Unpublished.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity[Unpublished.Dismissed.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity > 0], na.rm = TRUE))
  )
```

```{r}

library(gt)

intraday_data <- data.frame(
  cbind(
    t(round(count)), t(round(mean, 1)),
    t(round(predict_count)), t(round(predict_mean, 1)), 
    t(round(nuclear_count)), t(round(nuclear_mean,1))
  )
)
rownames(intraday_data) <- c("Published",  "Unpublished")#,"Published Dismissed", "Unpublished Dismissed")
# Create a gt table with styling
# Convert data to a data frame and transpose it
gt_table <- as.data.frame(t(intraday_data)) %>%
  mutate(
    Row_Label = c("Nbre", "Avg Unavailability", "Nbre", "Avg Unavailability", "Nbre", "Avg Unavailability") # Adding row labels
  ) %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Row_Label") %>%  # Set row labels
  tab_row_group(
    group = "All Declared",
    rows = 1:2  # Rows 1 and 2 for Predicted
  ) %>%
  tab_row_group(
    group = "Predicted",
    rows = 3:4  # Rows 1 and 2 for Predicted
  ) %>%
  tab_row_group(
    group = "Nuclear",
    rows = 5:6  # Rows 3 and 4 for Nuclear
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "bottom", color = "gray", weight = px(2)),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = everything())
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100)
  )

gt_table
```





```{r}

data <- rbind(intraday_data, data_dayahead_data )

    Row_Label = c(
      "Nbre", "Avg Unavailability", 
      "Nbre", "Avg Unavailability", 
      "Nbre", "Avg Unavailability"
    )
  )

colnames(gt_data)[1:4] <- c("Published", "Unpublished", "Published ", "Unpublished ")

gt_table <- gt_data %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Row_Label") %>%
  tab_row_group(
    group = "All Declared",
    rows = 1:2
  ) %>%
  tab_row_group(
    group = "Predicted",
    rows = 3:4
  ) %>%
  tab_row_group(
    group = "Nuclear",
    rows = 5:6
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Intraday",
    columns = c("Published", "Unpublished")
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Day-Ahead",
    columns = c("Published ", "Unpublished ")
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "bottom", color = "gray", weight = px(2)),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = everything())
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100)
  )

gt_table
```
